title: Python: audit hash_32 calls for byte order and identifier width
description:
Per spec 2a.10.7, verify all hash_32/fnv1a32 calls use:
- Network byte order (big-endian) for multi-byte inputs
- Full 16-byte DODAG ID where applicable (not truncated to 8 bytes)
Check: ccp.py, timing/sfn.py, link/channel.py, link/sf_assignment.py
Add test vectors to hash_32.json if missing.
